output.text: The community garden project has grown quickly this spring, with volunteers arriving at different times to help prepare the beds. Assume that Ben is the treasurer. Dev arrived earliest of the group, showing up before the sun had fully risen, while Gus came a little later carrying tools from his truck. Mina and Leo walked over together from the parking area, chatting about which vegetables to plant first. Gus booked the hall. Ben is taller than Dev, though both are shorter than Leo, who towers over most of the volunteers. Mina is on the same team as Leo. The soil needed turning before anything could be planted, and several people pitched in with shovels and rakes. Dev is older than Gus by a few years, and Ben is the youngest of everyone working that morning. Leo is not on the same team as Dev. Someone brought extra gloves for the newcomers, since the mornings had been chilly and damp lately. Mina is not on the same team as Dev. Ben ranked highest in the seed-sorting contest last week, beating both Gus and Dev by a wide margin. As the afternoon wore on, the group took a break to share sandwiches near the toolshed, comparing notes on which rows still needed weeding. Gus mentioned that the compost bins were nearly full again, and Mina offered to help empty them before the weekend. Everyone agreed the garden was looking better than it had in years, with new sprouts pushing up along the fence line where Leo and Dev had worked separately earlier that week.
